query:
WITH new_archive AS (
            INSERT INTO archives (retro_id) VALUES ($1) RETURNING id
        )
        UPDATE items
        SET status = 'ARCHIVED'::status,
            archive_id = new_archive.id,
            archived_at = NOW()
        FROM new_archive
        WHERE items.retro_id = $1
          AND items.archive_id IS NULL
        RETURNING items.id
